status_summary: On 2025-02-14 the NLRB Acting General Counsel issued GC 25-05, permanently rescinding the 2024 memorandum on 10(j) relief after Starbucks v. McKinney and rescinding three earlier 10(j) memoranda pending further guidance, which runs against the recommendation to expand 10(j) use. On 2026-08-26 the General Counsel issued GC 26-04 listing precedents to ask the Board to revisit, including the 2023 Stericycle workplace-rules standard and the totality-of-the-circumstances standard for individual protected concerted activity. The summary read does not mention Alstate Maintenance or 10(j), and no Board decision returning to the 2019 standard was found.

timeline.event: The Acting General Counsel issued GC 25-05, permanently rescinding GC 24-05 and rescinding GC 21-05, 22-02 and 23-01 on Section 10(j) injunctions pending further guidance, along with other prior memoranda.
timeline.source: NLRB Office of the General Counsel (memorandum copy on DocumentCloud)

timeline.event: The General Counsel issued GC 26-04 identifying Board precedents to be revisited, including Stericycle and the standard for individual protected concerted activity.

title: Return to the 2019 protected concerted activity standard and expand 10(j) injunction use
uncertainties: GC 25-05 was read from a copy hosted on DocumentCloud, not the NLRB website. GC 26-04 itself was not opened; its content comes from an undated law-firm blog post. Whether the General Counsel has issued new 10(j) guidance since GC 25-05, or the Board has decided a relevant case, was not found in a review search. The 2019 Alstate Maintenance standard was displaced by a 2023 Board decision, which the Mandate's request would reverse; that decision was not opened. The two parts of the recommendation point in different directions: the concerted-activity part shows General Counsel positions in line with it, while the 10(j) part shows a step against it.
